gbm_population_evidence.quote: Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors; GIST; Non-resectable Advanced Solid Tumors; Recurrent or Unresectable Central Nervous System (CNS) Tumors
Confirmed diagnosis of recurrent or unresectable CNS tumors including :IDH-mutant astrocytoma, IDH-mutant oligodendroglioma, glioblastoma, H3K27-altered diffuse midline glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: Participants with CNS tumors will receive avapritinib 300 mg daily orally, until Day 56.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Non-resectable advance solid tumor with KIT mutation with progression following standard of care treatment.

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive avapritinib 300 mg daily, orally on starting on Day 3.

arms: Participants with metastatic, unresectable GIST, non-CNS solid tumors, or CNS tumors

role_evidence.quote: A Drug-drug Interaction Study of Avapritinib and Midazolam

agents.drug_class_hint: benzodiazepine, CYP3A4 probe substrate for drug-drug interaction assessment
arms: Participants with metastatic, unresectable GIST, non-CNS solid tumors, or CNS tumors

source_quote.quote: ---Non-resectable advance solid tumor with KIT mutation with progression following standard of care treatment.

flag.reason: KIT mutation is required only for the GIST and non-CNS solid tumour routes, not for the CNS tumour (glioblastoma) route; whether this counts as selection for the trial's GBM population is doubtful.

coder_notes: Drug-drug interaction study with a single arm; midazolam is a probe substrate (not antitumour) and coded supportive as the closest role. PK is plasma only. Other CNS tumour types (IDH-mutant, H3K27-altered) are allowed alongside glioblastoma; molecular subtypes are diagnostic categories, not required biomarkers. PDGFRA mutation is an exclusion for GIST only.
